def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    from calendar import monthrange
    
    # Parse the input date
    year, month, date = map(int, day.split('-'))
    
    # Check if the input day is the last day of its month
    _, last_day_of_input_month = monthrange(year, month)
    is_last_day = (date == last_day_of_input_month)
    
    # Add n months
    month += n
    
    # Adjust year and month for wraparound
    while month > 12:
        month -= 12
        year += 1
    while month < 1:
        month += 12
        year -= 1
    
    # Get the last day of the target month
    _, last_day_of_target_month = monthrange(year, month)
    
    # Apply billing rule
    if is_last_day:
        # If input was last day of its month, result is last day of target month
        result_day = last_day_of_target_month
    else:
        # Otherwise, keep the same day, or use last day if target month is too short
        result_day = min(date, last_day_of_target_month)
    
    # Return formatted date
    return f"{year:04d}-{month:02d}-{result_day:02d}"
